hero.subtitle: Products, orders, stock and cash flow — all in one place, with the right access for every role on your team.

feature.heading: Everything Your Operation Needs
feature.subheading: A complete toolkit for managing your catalog, order flow and back-office operations.
feature.catalog_description: Model products, variants, options and bundles, with availability windows and per-channel pricing.
feature.orders_description: Follow an order from placement to shipping, with numbered documents allocated from a shared series.
feature.cash_flow_description: Record income and expenses per client or vendor, with a full operational history.
feature.directory_description: Keep a shared directory of clients, vendors, brands and addresses across the whole team.
feature.permissions_description: Grant per-entity, per-operation access so admins and operators only see what they need.
feature.dashboard_description: Every entity — users, logs, mail queue, templates — managed from a single, consistent CRUD interface.

cta.back_description: Jump into the admin dashboard to manage users, catalog, orders and more.
cta.ready_description: Create an account to manage your catalog, orders and team in one dashboard.
